story.fullStory:
Johnny Cash's "I Walk The Line" — original release 1956. "I Walk the Line" is a song written and recorded in 1956 by Johnny Cash.

After moderate chart success, it soon became Cash's first #1 hit on the Billboard country chart, and eventually crossed over to the pop charts, reaching #19 on the Billboard "Top 100" (later renamed "Hot 100").

The song remained on the charts for over 43 weeks, and sold over two million copies.

The albums discography of American singer Johnny Cash spans his lengthy career, from 1954 to 2003.
